subject: `BF.INFO`: documentation and reabability nits (#104)
reason: The change is purely cosmetic: it reorders two mutually exclusive string-literal match arms (EXPANSION/TIGHTENING) inside bloom_filter_info, which cannot alter which arm matches or any BF.INFO reply, and edits src/commands/bf.info.json, a documentation-only metadata file that no code loads (no build.rs, no include_str!; the command table comes from the valkey_module! macro in src/lib.rs). No observable behaviour — replies, errors, persistence, or replication — differs between the parent and the change, so a compared sequence could only produce 'difference expected but not found' errors, not fi
